verdict.rationale: Vast.ai explicitly ships 'Vast Serverless', described as letting users run compute-intensive workloads 'without managing GPUs, paying for execution rather than GPU rental time,' with a Python SDK and CLI support for deploying endpoints — matching the pay-per-execution serverless model a developer would want instead of always-on instances. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms autoscaling behavior or scale-to-zero semantics, nor gives hands-on/independent corroboration of how workers scale under load. Missing for 10: explicit autoscaling/scale-to-zero documentation, independent or hands-on validation of serverless endpoint behavior, and details on cold-start/latency tradeoffs.
